import json, subprocess, sys

DIR = {
  "sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],

  "sip:other@studio.test": [],
  "sip:remote@far.test": ["sip:r1@alias.far.test"],
  "sip:two@studio.test": ["tel:+12025550123"],
}
ACC = {
  "session-k": {"primary":"sip:ember@studio.test","allow":["sip:desk@sales.test","sip:other@studio.test","sip:two@studio.test"]},
  "far": {"primary":"sip:remote@far.test","allow":[]},
}
GW = {
  "edge": {"local_domains":["studio.test","sales.test"],"peers":{}},
  "inside": {"local_domains":[],"peers":{"edge":["studio.test","sales.test"],"far":["far.test"]}},
  "narrow": {"local_domains":["studio.test"],"peers":{"edge":["sales.test"]}},
  "selfhost": {"local_domains":["studio.test"],"peers":{"edge":["studio.test"]}},
}

def mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7", to="<sip:inbox@relay.test>", extra="", body="hello",
       method="MESSAGE", cseq="9 MESSAGE", clen=None, callid="sample-73"):
    if clen is None: clen=len(body)
    return (f"{method} sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\n"
            f"From: {fromhdr}\r\n"
            f"To: {to}\r\n"
            f"Call-ID: {callid}\r\n"
            f"CSeq: {cseq}\r\n" + extra + f"Content-Length: {clen}\r\n\r\n{body}")

def job(gw, ingress, raw=None, source=None, trusted=True):
    j={"gateway":gw,"ingress":ingress,"trusted_out":trusted}
    if source is not None: j["source"]=source
    else: j["raw"]=raw
    return j

LOC={"kind":"local","subject":"session-k"}
LOCFAR={"kind":"local","subject":"far"}
PEER={"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}
PEERFAR={"kind":"peer","name":"far"}
UNTR={"kind":"untrusted"}

cases=[]
def add(name,j,expect,note=""):
    cases.append((name,j,expect,note))

# --- From/To address forms ---
add("bare uri from", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="sip:ember@studio.test")), "accept")
add("bare uri from no tag", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="sip:ember@studio.test")), "accept")
add("display unquoted", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="Bob <sip:ember@studio.test>")), "accept")
add("display quoted", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr='"Bob" <sip:ember@studio.test>')), "accept")
add("display quoted no space", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr='"Bob"<sip:ember@studio.test>')), "accept")
add("display multiword", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="Bob Smith <sip:ember@studio.test>")), "accept")
add("display with comma quoted", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr='"A, B" <sip:ember@studio.test>')), "accept")
add("display with comma unquoted", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="A, B <sip:ember@studio.test>")), "syntax")
add("display with semicolon unquoted", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="A; B <sip:ember@studio.test>")), "syntax")
add("unterminated quote", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr='"Bob <sip:ember@studio.test>')), "syntax")
add("dangling escape", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr='"Bob\\ <sip:ember@studio.test>')), "syntax")
add("escaped quote ok", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr='"Bob\\"x" <sip:ember@studio.test>')), "accept")
add("nested angle", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<<sip:ember@studio.test>>")), "syntax")
add("empty address", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<>")), "syntax")
add("empty address bare", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="")), "syntax")
add("stray text", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test> junk")), "syntax")
add("two addresses in From", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test>, <sip:other@studio.test>")), "syntax")
add("tag spaces", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test> ; tag = q7 ")), "accept")
add("tag case", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test>;TAG=q7")), "accept")
add("tag empty", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=")), "syntax")
add("tag too long", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test>;tag="+"a"*129)), "syntax")
add("tag 128", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test>;tag="+"a"*128)), "accept")
add("other param", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test>;transport=tcp")), "syntax")
add("tag on PPI", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=x\r\n")), "syntax")
add("two in PPI", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>, <sip:other@studio.test>\r\n")), "syntax")
add("tel in PPI", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Preferred-Identity: <tel:+12025550121>\r\n")), "accept")
add("anon in PPI", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>\r\n")), "syntax")
add("anon in RPID", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="Remote-Party-ID: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>\r\n")), "syntax")
add("anon in PAI", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>\r\n")), "syntax")
add("PAI two sip", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>, <sip:other@studio.test>\r\n")), "syntax")
add("PAI sip+tel", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>, <tel:+12025550121>\r\n")), "accept")
add("PAI two headers", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\nP-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550121>\r\n")), "accept")
add("PAI three", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>, <tel:+12025550121>\r\nP-Asserted-Identity: <sip:other@studio.test>\r\n")), "syntax")
add("PAI empty member", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>,,\r\n")), "syntax")
add("PAI trailing comma", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>,\r\n")), "syntax")
add("PAI quoted comma", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra='P-Asserted-Identity: "A, B" <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n')), "accept")

# --- URI grammar ---
add("user escape", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:%65mber@studio.test>")), "accept")
add("user escape bad", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:%zzmber@studio.test>")), "syntax")
add("user escape to space", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:a%20b@studio.test>")), "syntax")
add("host upper", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@STUDIO.TEST>")), "accept")
add("host trailing dot", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test.>")), "accept")
add("host double dot", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio..test>")), "syntax")
add("host leading hyphen", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@-studio.test>")), "syntax")
add("host underscore", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio_test>")), "syntax")
add("host empty", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@>")), "syntax")
add("host escape", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@stu%64io.test>")), "syntax")
add("host long label", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@"+"a"*64+".test>")), "syntax")
add("port", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test:5060>")), "syntax")
add("uri param", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test;transport=tcp>")), "syntax")
add("password", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:user:pw@studio.test>")), "syntax")
add("sips", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sips:ember@studio.test>")), "syntax")
add("tel ok", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<tel:+12025550121>")), "accept")
add("tel no plus", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<tel:12025550121>")), "syntax")
add("tel leading zero", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<tel:+0123456789>")), "syntax")
add("tel 16 digits", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<tel:+1234567890123456>")), "syntax")
add("tel 15 digits", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<tel:+123456789012345>")), "syntax")
add("empty user", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:@studio.test>")), "syntax")
add("numeric host label", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@192.168.1.1>")), "syntax")
add("user case sensitive", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:Ember@studio.test>")), "identity")
add("scheme case", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<SIP:ember@studio.test>")), "accept")

# --- identity policy ---
add("local unknown subject", job("edge",{"kind":"local","subject":"nope"},mk()), "unauthenticated")
add("local unknown from", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:unknown@studio.test>")), "identity")
add("local from not allowed", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:remote@far.test>")), "identity")
add("local from not hosted", job("edge","narrow"and {"kind":"local","subject":"session-k"},mk(fromhdr="<sip:desk@sales.test>")), "identity")
add("local alias resolves", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:e1@alias.studio.test>")), "accept")
add("local tel alias resolves", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<tel:+12025550121>")), "accept")
add("local ppi selects", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:ember@studio.test>",extra="P-Preferred-Identity: <tel:+12025550122>\r\n")), "accept")
add("local ppi unknown", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:zz@studio.test>\r\n")), "identity")
add("local ppi not allowed", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:remote@far.test>\r\n")), "identity")
add("local ppi not hosted", job("edge","narrow"and {"kind":"local","subject":"session-k"},mk(extra="P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>\r\n")), "identity")
add("local anon from -> primary", job("edge",LOC,mk(fromhdr="<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>")), "accept")
add("local PAI ignored", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:remote@far.test>\r\n")), "accept")
add("local RPID ignored", job("edge",LOC,mk(extra="Remote-Party-ID: <sip:remote@far.test>\r\n")), "accept")
add("untrusted", job("edge",UNTR,mk()), "unauthenticated")
add("peer unknown", job("inside",{"kind":"peer","name":"nope"},mk()), "unauthenticated")
add("peer no PAI", job("inside",PEER,mk()), "unauthenticated")
add("peer ok", job("inside",PEER,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n")), "accept")
add("peer alias ok", job("inside",PEER,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:e1@alias.studio.test>\r\n")), "accept")
add("peer authority violation", job("narrow",PEER,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n")), "identity")
add("peer from mismatch", job("inside",PEER,mk(fromhdr="<sip:desk@sales.test>",extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n")), "identity")
add("peer ppi mismatch", job("inside",PEER,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\nP-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>\r\n")), "identity")
add("peer rpid mismatch", job("inside",PEER,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\nRemote-Party-ID: <sip:desk@sales.test>\r\n")), "identity")
add("peer rpid match", job("inside",PEER,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\nRemote-Party-ID: <sip:e1@alias.studio.test>\r\n")), "accept")
add("peer anon from ok", job("inside",PEER,mk(fromhdr="<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>",extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n")), "accept")
add("peer PAI unknown", job("inside",PEER,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:zz@studio.test>\r\n")), "identity")
add("peer PAI two different", job("inside",PEER,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>, <sip:desk@sales.test>\r\n")), "identity")
add("peer PAI sip+tel same", job("inside",PEER,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>, <tel:+12025550121>\r\n")), "accept")
add("peer far domain", job("inside",PEERFAR,mk(fromhdr="<sip:remote@far.test>",extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:remote@far.test>\r\n")), "accept")
add("peer local domain authority", job("selfhost",PEER,mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n")), "accept")
add("peer not authoritative for local", job("edge",{"kind":"peer","name":"edge"},mk(extra="P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n")), "unauthenticated")

batch={"directory":DIR,"accounts":ACC,"gateways":GW,"jobs":[c[1] for c in cases]}
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],input=json.dumps(batch).encode(),capture_output=True)
if out.returncode!=0:
    print("EXIT",out.returncode,out.stderr.decode()[:3000]); sys.exit(1)
res=json.loads(out.stdout)["results"]
bad=0
for (name,j,expect,note),r in zip(cases,res):
    got=r.get("reason") if r.get("status")=="reject" else "accept"
    if got!=expect:
        bad+=1
        print(f"MISMATCH {name}: expected {expect} got {got} :: {json.dumps(r)[:160]}")
print("total",len(cases),"mismatches",bad)
PYEOF
python3 tmp/t2.py
